decisions.reason: This compact dumper extends the established construction range and keeps its own page in both years, so it meets the aspiration with no shortfall that would trigger search.
This articulated dumper builds on core competencies and keeps a stable web presence, so it fits the mature range and gives no reason to reallocate resources.

The rescue vehicle is distant from the core and fell from its own page to a mere mention in 2024, suggesting results below aspiration, but slack from a growing, hiring firm lets it carry this niche product for now.
This compact telescopic loader is close to the established offer and keeps its own page in both years, so management sees no shortfall that warrants dropping it.
